legacy_payload.control_levers: CIN-aware IO strategies; consider STING agonists where reversible; adjust IO intensity to CIN burden
legacy_payload.mechanism: Chronic WGD/CIN represses cGAS–STING signaling, driving an immunosuppressive TIME
legacy_payload.notes: Biphasic with acute DDR—requires explicit context tagging.
legacy_payload.readouts: WGD score; aneuploidy metrics; STING1 expression; IFN/immune signatures; myeloid-inflamed TIME
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

legacy_payload.control_levers: Schedule PARP/ATR/CHK1 with ICI to capture STING/IFN burst while managing toxicity
legacy_payload.mechanism: Acute DNA damage generates cytosolic DNA, activating cGAS–STING and type I IFN, priming IO
legacy_payload.notes: Opposes chronic WGD/CIN effect; edge must be tagged as acute.
legacy_payload.readouts: pSTING; pIRF3; type I IFN signatures; acute DDR markers
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

legacy_payload.context: ALT or telomerase insufficiency; telomere crisis
legacy_payload.control_levers: Monitor telomere status; explore telomerase/ALT-directed strategies when translationally ready
legacy_payload.mechanism: Telomere crisis generates dicentrics and breakage–fusion–bridge cycles, causing aneuploidy and chromothripsis
legacy_payload.notes: Key Seed→Switch edge; locks telomere biology into CIN/WGD.
legacy_payload.readouts: Telomere fusions; dicentric chromosomes; telomere length; ALT markers
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

legacy_payload.control_levers: Combine ecDNA payload inhibitors with CHK1/ATR; deploy replication-conflict targeting agents (e.g., BBI-2779-class)
legacy_payload.mechanism: ecDNA amplicons create high transcriptional output and replication–transcription conflicts, generating RS and CHK1 dependency
legacy_payload.notes: Translational Nature/NCI data support ecDNA-linked RS/CHK1 vulnerability.
legacy_payload.readouts: ecDNA by WGS/FISH; AmpliconArchitect/circle-seq; RS gene signatures; γH2AX; pCHK1
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

legacy_payload.context: hypoxia; high glycolysis; acidic and adenosine-rich niche

legacy_payload.notes: Core immunometabolic bottleneck with multiple drugs in or near clinical testing.
legacy_payload.readouts: MCT1/4 expression; extracellular pH; A2A axis markers; hypoxia signatures
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

legacy_payload.context: desmoplastic, stiff stroma; high LOX/YAP–TAZ activity

legacy_payload.notes: Mechanobiology overlay edge; connects Sink to Spread and resistance.
legacy_payload.readouts: LOX activity; stiffness metrics (e.g., elastography); YAP/TAZ target gene expression; vessel maturity indices
legacy_payload.source_hint: MVCL v1.2 core edge spine; see master SSOT Appendix A

Scientific or model admission does not authorize clinical action.
Microscopic Markovity does not establish macroscopic Markovity.
Full mature MVCL reinforcement is not required as the first-onset definition.
Newer filenames and timestamps do not determine scientific authority.
A single adapter does not establish a pan-cancer claim.
Temporal order is not causal mediation.
Pathology labels do not define the latent regime by fiat.
Software QA is not biological validation.
Surveillance schedules are not ignorable by default.
Positive selection does not establish cancer causation.
Duplicate identifiers and shared cohorts are not independent evidence.
Spatial colocation does not establish a constitutive niche.
OoL/FFBBP thresholds do not transfer to cancer by renaming.
Unknown or unidentifiable is not a negative experimental finding.

Multistage carcinogenesis
purpose: Foundational waiting-time / multi-hit model; defines what later theories must add beyond event count.

label: Two-hit tumour suppressor model
purpose: Separates inherited starting state from later somatic events and motivates stage-specific boundary semantics.

label: Clonal evolution
purpose: Core ancestry + selection foundation; must distinguish evolutionary history from malignant establishment.

label: Genetic progression models
purpose: Canonical ordered-progression model and challenge case for route/order inference.

canonical_reading_leads: Berenblum/Shubik historical two-stage promotion; modern W5
label: Tumour promotion
purpose: Separates mutation creation from altered selection / context.

label: Tissue Organization Field Theory
purpose: Strong alternative to cell-autonomous mutation-first ontology; key adversarial theory.

label: Adaptive oncogenesis / aged microenvironment
purpose: Explains why identical mutations can differ in fitness as tissue context changes.

canonical_reading_leads: Merlo et al.; Aktipis/Maley; Gatenby/Gillies corpus
label: Evolutionary ecology of cancer
purpose: Frequency dependence, cooperation, competition, public goods and niche construction.

canonical_reading_leads: Slaughter et al. (1953) + modern field evolution studies
label: Field cancerization
purpose: Tests lesion boundary, spatial founder ensembles and multiple-neoplasm origin semantics.

label: Cell-of-origin / cancer stem-cell theories
purpose: Separates susceptible normal lineage from first malignant founder and later CSC state.

label: Developmental cancer theory
purpose: Forces low-mutation, fetal-lineage and chromatin-driven adapters.

label: Immune surveillance / immunoediting
purpose: Candidate restoring force and possible establishment barrier; route-specific necessity must be tested.

label: Niche construction / multicellular establishment
purpose: Potentially makes stroma/immune cells constitutive components of establishment.

label: Critical-transition / attractor theories
purpose: Defines prior art for tipping-point and regime language and provides falsifiable alternative formulations.

label: Two-stage clonal expansion / stochastic carcinogenesis
purpose: Connects event timing, clone expansion and incidence; candidate bridge to establishment hazards.

label: Branching-process survival / extinction
purpose: Candidate mathematical semantics for early clone establishment; may fail for multicellular niches.

label: Metastability / quasi-stationarity
purpose: Potential formalism for long-lived precancer and transient malignant-like excursions.

label: Multistate / semi-Markov natural history
purpose: Needed for entry vs establishment vs regression, dwell times, surveillance and competing events.

label: Lineage reconstruction / phylogenetics
purpose: Needed for ancestry continuity without laundering order into causality.

canonical_reading_leads: SCM / mediation / partial-ID methods + cancer applications
label: Causal inference / mediation / partial identification
purpose: Defines what route and constitutive claims can be inferred from observational and perturbational data.

label: Precancer / pathology ontology
purpose: External reference surface for benign→precursor→in situ→invasive categories without circular definition.

canonical_reading_leads: Longitudinal precursor and spontaneous regression literature
label: Regression / non-progression theories
purpose: Negative outcomes are necessary to distinguish capability from establishment.

label: Neutral evolution / drift nulls
purpose: Adversarial null against selection-heavy origin narratives.

label: Infection-driven origins
